column1: # Why each corpus ROM admits zero descriptor tables, measured 2026-08-05.
# Produced by examples/probe_zero_admitted_cause.rs over all 287 ROMs.
# 246 ROMs fail with NoUniqueAdmittedTable{admitted:0}; this splits that
# bucket by CAUSE, because the causes need different fixes:
#   NO_CANDIDATES              229  the family search enumerated NOTHING.
#                                   field layout, vram window) does not
#                                   occur in the ROM at all.
#                                   EVERY one has best_mapped=0 -- not a
#                                   marginal floor miss; the regions do not
#                                   decode as loadable code, so lowering
#   ADMITTED_<n>                48  n tables admitted (n=1 is unique).
# CONSEQUENCE: no admission-rule tuning reaches 80% of the corpus. Those
# ROMs need a DIFFERENT descriptor family (see vrom_family, or per-overlay
# headers as in Bomberman 64), not a looser AKI-family threshold.
# FOLLOW-UP MEASUREMENT (2026-08-05) -- the ceiling is lower than "a second
# family" implies, and this is the number that should drive planning:
#   186 / 229 (81%)  have NO CODE OVERLAYS AT ALL. >=95% of every JR RA sits
#                    in ONE leading resident span. Independently reproduced on
#                    Super Mario 64: 5,198 JR RA, 0.84 of them below 0x200000.
#                    No descriptor family can unlock these -- there is nothing
#                    to describe. They are single-bank games.
#                    Pokemon Stadium, Sin & Punishment). Their descriptors are
#                    SCATTERED POINTER REFERENCES, not contiguous arrays --
#                    ISS 2000's off-bank code at 0x260000 is referenced by 550
#                    ROM words, none as an adjacent triple.
#                    indirect and Yaz0-compressed (1457/1510 entries in OoT).
# WHY THE SEARCH FINDS NOTHING: overlay_regions/mod.rs:371-378 hard-codes three
# ADJACENT words [rom_start][rom_end][vram_dest]. All 6 field permutations were
# tested across 224 ROMs and NO permutation helps; apparent hits are counter
# arrays with jrra=0 in their regions. Relaxing the field layout is worth 0
# So the realistic ceiling for table-shaped discovery is ~48 + 15-25 = 63-73 of
# 287, not 287. "All N64 ROM support" via one more descriptor family is not
# available; the single-bank majority needs no overlay discovery at all.
